description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Animal Production and Health Service- 03rd Amendment
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the service minute (terms of service) for the Sri Lanka Animal Production and Health Service, specifically addressing educational and professional qualifications for officers. This falls under public sector service conditions and administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel change (which would be Type 2 or 3) or any other specialized category.
